channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Seventh Moment of Silence Honors 9/11 Health Victims
item.description: The 9/11 Memorial & Museum added a seventh moment of silence at this year's ceremony to honor those who died from illnesses related to their time at Ground Zero.

item.title: U.S. diesel prices reach $6 per gallon for first time
item.description: Diesel prices have risen over 60% in the past year, and energy experts expect the increase to persist. Here is why.

item.title: Nashville airport to be renamed for Dolly Parton after unanimous vote
item.description: The Metro Nashville Airport Authority board voted 6-0 on Friday to start the renaming process and said a final name has not been selected.

item.title: Diesel reaches record $6 a gallon as Houthis seize Red Sea territory
item.description: U.S. diesel prices have reached a new high of $6 a gallon, as reports said Houthi rebels in Yemen captured key territory along the Red Sea.
